# params only exists during knit; running chunks by hand needs this fallback

# Purpose

Where does one gene sit, for mRNA and translation efficiency (TE), relative to every other
gene in the same contrast? Two sets of contrasts in MDA-MB-231:

- **Control cells (siCTRL), hypoxia vs normoxia** at 1, 4 and 24hr - `log2(hypoxia / normoxia)`.
- **eIF3d knockdown**, hypoxia 1hr and normoxia 1+4hr time-regressed - `log2(sictrl / si3d)`.
  The files are named `si3d_vs_sictrl` but the DESeq2 coefficient is `sictrl_vs_si3d`, so
  positive = the knockdown lowers it = eIF3d promotes it.

Showing the whole distribution is the point. si3d lowers total mRNA per cell, so the typical
gene's `rna_lfc` is about +0.4 to +0.5; a gene can be "significant" for mRNA purely by
following that global shift. Hypoxia likewise lowers TE globally from 4hr. The percentile
printed next to each point separates a gene-specific change from the global one.

```{r libs}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)

GENE_ID    <- params$gene_id
GENE_LABEL <- params$gene_label
GENE_COL   <- "#0072B2"   # Okabe-Ito dark blue; orange / sky blue are reserved for si3d / si3e
REST_COL   <- "grey70"
```

# Load

Every gene DESeq2 tested in a contrast (non-NA `te_padj`) is kept, so each violin is that
contrast's full tested set.

```{r load}
read_contrast <- function(file, label) {
  read_csv(here("output", file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(te_padj)) %>%
    mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id), contrast = label) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, contrast, rna_lfc, rna_padj, te_lfc, te_padj)
}

ctrl <- bind_rows(
  read_contrast("translation_categories_1hr.csv",  "1hr"),
  read_contrast("translation_categories_4hr.csv",  "4hr"),
  read_contrast("translation_categories_24hr.csv", "24hr")
) %>% mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, c("1hr", "4hr", "24hr")))

kd <- bind_rows(
  read_contrast("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv",      "Hypoxia 1hr"),
  read_contrast("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_normoxia_1and4hr.csv", "Normoxia 1+4hr\n(time-regressed)")
) %>% mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, unique(contrast)))
```

# Direction checks

Neither filename can be trusted for direction, so each is checked against biology:

- **Knockdown:** EIF3D's own mRNA must be strongly positive, because the siRNA depletes it.
- **Control:** NDRG1, a canonical HIF target, must be induced by 24hr if the file is
  hypoxia / normoxia.

```{r direction_checks}
eif3d_rna <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(sub("\\..*", "", gene_id) == "ENSG00000100353") %>% pull(rna_lfc)
ndrg1_24 <- ctrl %>% filter(gene_id_clean == "ENSG00000104419", contrast == "24hr") %>% pull(rna_lfc)

stopifnot(
  "si3d direction flipped: EIF3D rna_lfc not strongly positive" = eif3d_rna > 1.5,
  "control direction flipped: NDRG1 not induced at 24hr hypoxia" = ndrg1_24 > 1,
  "gene missing from a control contrast"   = nrow(filter(ctrl, gene_id_clean == GENE_ID)) == 3,
  "gene missing from a knockdown contrast" = nrow(filter(kd,   gene_id_clean == GENE_ID)) == 2
)
cat("EIF3D rna_lfc (si3d, hypoxia 1hr):", round(eif3d_rna, 2),
    "\nNDRG1 rna_lfc (control, 24hr):   ", round(ndrg1_24, 2), "\n")
```

# Table

```{r table}
summarise_gene <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(
      n          = n(),
      median_rna = median(rna_lfc, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_te  = median(te_lfc),
      rna_pct    = mean(rna_lfc <= rna_lfc[gene_id_clean == GENE_ID], na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      te_pct     = mean(te_lfc  <= te_lfc[gene_id_clean == GENE_ID]) * 100,
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(d %>% filter(gene_id_clean == GENE_ID) %>%
                dplyr::select(contrast, rna_lfc, rna_padj, te_lfc, te_padj), by = "contrast") %>%
    dplyr::select(contrast, rna_lfc, rna_padj, rna_pct, median_rna,
                  te_lfc, te_padj, te_pct, median_te, n)
}

tab <- bind_rows(summarise_gene(ctrl) %>% mutate(set = "Control: hypoxia vs normoxia"),
                 summarise_gene(kd)   %>% mutate(set = "eIF3d knockdown: sictrl vs si3d")) %>%
  relocate(set)
knitr::kable(tab, digits = c(0, 0, 2, 4, 0, 2, 2, 4, 0, 2, 0),
             caption = paste0(GENE_LABEL, ": log2FC, padj, percentile among all tested genes, ",
                              "and the transcriptome median for that contrast"))
```

# Figure

```{r figure}
to_long <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    pivot_longer(c(rna_lfc, te_lfc), names_to = "measure", values_to = "lfc") %>%
    mutate(padj = if_else(measure == "rna_lfc", rna_padj, te_padj),
           measure = factor(if_else(measure == "rna_lfc", "mRNA", "TE"), c("mRNA", "TE"))) %>%
    filter(is.finite(lfc))
}

# "*" padj < 0.05, "ns" tested but not significant, blank when no contrast exists
stars <- function(p) case_when(is.na(p) ~ "", p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns")
ordinal <- function(x) {
  x <- round(x)
  suf <- ifelse(x %% 100 %in% 11:13, "th", c("th", "st", "nd", "rd", rep("th", 6))[x %% 10 + 1])
  paste0(x, suf)
}

panel <- function(d, title, ylab) {
  long <- to_long(d)
  pt <- long %>% filter(gene_id_clean == GENE_ID)
  pct <- long %>% group_by(contrast, measure) %>%
    summarise(pct = mean(lfc <= lfc[gene_id_clean == GENE_ID]) * 100, n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  pt <- pt %>% left_join(pct, by = c("contrast", "measure")) %>%
    mutate(lab = sprintf("%+.2f %s\n%s pct", lfc, stars(padj), ordinal(pct)))
  n_lab <- pct %>% group_by(measure) %>%
    summarise(lab = paste0("n = ", format(min(n), big.mark = ","),
                           if (min(n) != max(n)) paste0("-", format(max(n), big.mark = ",")) else ""),
              .groups = "drop")
  # Clip the y range to the bulk of the distribution (0.5-99.5%) so the medians are readable,
  # always keeping the gene's own point in range.
  lims <- long %>% group_by(measure) %>%
    summarise(lo = min(quantile(lfc, 0.005), min(pt$lfc[pt$measure == cur_group()$measure])) - 0.3,
              hi = max(quantile(lfc, 0.995), max(pt$lfc[pt$measure == cur_group()$measure])) + 0.3,
              .groups = "drop")
  long <- long %>% left_join(lims, by = "measure") %>% filter(lfc >= lo, lfc <= hi)

  ggplot(long, aes(x = contrast, y = lfc)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_violin(fill = REST_COL, colour = NA, alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", width = 0.8) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", colour = "grey30",
                 linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = pt, colour = GENE_COL, size = 3.2) +
    geom_text(data = pt, aes(label = lab), colour = GENE_COL, size = 3.1,
              hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.22, lineheight = 0.9) +
    geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3, size = 3.1, colour = "grey30") +
    facet_wrap(~ measure, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.9))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 13),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
}

pA <- panel(ctrl, "Control cells: hypoxia vs normoxia", "log2(hypoxia / normoxia)")
pB <- panel(kd,   "eIF3d knockdown",                    "log2(sictrl / si3d)")

p <- (pA | pB) + plot_layout(widths = c(3, 2.2)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste(GENE_LABEL, "in MDA-MB-231"),
    subtitle = paste0("Blue point = ", GENE_LABEL,
                      "; grey = all genes tested in that contrast (box = median and IQR).\n",
                      "Label: log2FC (* = padj < 0.05) and percentile among all genes. ",
                      "Positive in the knockdown panel = si3d lowers it."),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)))
p

if (params$save_plots) {
  out <- here("plots", paste0("gene_rna_te_hypoxia_si3d_231_", GENE_LABEL, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(out, p, width = 11, height = 7.5)
  cat("Saved", out, "\n")
}
```

# Per-sample values

The figure above shows fold changes from DESeq2 contrasts. Here are the **values themselves**
for each sample, from the per-sample TE tables:

- **mRNA** and **ribosome footprints** = log2(spike-in normalised counts + 1).
- **TE** = log2(ribosome footprints) - log2(mRNA) for the matched ribosome and RNA library.

Bar = mean of the replicates, points = individual replicates. A star means the DESeq2 contrast
for that pair has padj < 0.05 and "ns" that it was tested and is not significant; the star comes from the same contrast tables used above, not
from a test on these points.

```{r value_helpers}
VALUE_NAMES <- c(rna = "mRNA", ribo = "Ribosome footprints", TE = "TE")
VALUE_UNITS <- c(rna = "log2(norm counts + 1)", ribo = "log2(norm counts + 1)", TE = "log2(ribo / mRNA)")

# Bars of replicate means, replicate points, and a padj label above each pair - one small plot
# per measure so each carries its own y-axis units. `sig` has one row per x position and
# measure, with that contrast's padj and log2FC. `x_labels` relabels the x ticks.
value_panel <- function(vals, x, fill, fill_values, sig, comparison, x_labels = waiver()) {
  one <- function(ms) {
    v <- vals %>% filter(measure == ms)
    means <- v %>% group_by(.data[[x]], .data[[fill]]) %>%
      summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop")
    # label sits above the taller of bar or points for that pair, offset by 8% of the range
    off <- 0.08 * diff(range(c(0, v$value)))
    star <- v %>% group_by(.data[[x]]) %>%
      summarise(y = max(c(0, value)) + off, .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(sig %>% filter(measure == ms) %>% dplyr::select(-measure), by = x) %>%
      filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
      # significant pairs carry the DESeq2 log2FC next to the star
      mutate(lab = if_else(padj < 0.05, sprintf("* %+.2f", lfc), "ns"))

    ggplot(v, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = value, fill = .data[[fill]])) +
      geom_col(data = means, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
      geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.75, seed = 9),
                 size = 1.6, shape = 21, colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_text(data = star, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = y, label = lab,
                                size = if_else(lab == "ns", 4, 4.5)),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_size_identity() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values, name = NULL) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
      labs(title = paste0(VALUE_NAMES[[ms]], ": ", comparison), x = NULL, y = VALUE_UNITS[[ms]]) +
      ggprism::theme_prism(base_size = 12) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 12),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11))
  }
  wrap_plots(lapply(intersect(names(VALUE_NAMES), unique(vals$measure)), one),
             nrow = 1, guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}
```

```{r values_231, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 4.5}
# Per-sample tables written by calculate_te_from_normalized_counts.Rmd, one per timepoint.
# Columns are {condition}_{treatment}_{hours}_{rep}_{TE|rna|ribo}_{sample id}.
read_values <- function(hr) {
  read_csv(here("output", sprintf("complete_te_list_all_%dhr.csv", hr)), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(sub("\\..*", "", gene_id) == GENE_ID) %>%
    dplyr::select(matches("_(TE|rna|ribo)_NM")) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "col", values_to = "value") %>%
    tidyr::extract(col, c("condition", "treatment", "hours", "rep", "measure"),
                   "^(normoxia|hypoxia)_(sictrl|si3e|si3d)_(\\d+)_([abc])_(TE|rna|ribo)_")
}
vals <- map_dfr(c(1, 4, 24), read_values) %>%
  filter(treatment %in% c("sictrl", "si3d")) %>%
  mutate(hours = factor(paste0(hours, "hr"), c("1hr", "4hr", "24hr")))
stopifnot("gene not found in the per-sample TE tables" = nrow(vals) > 0,
          "expected 3 replicates per group" =
            all(dplyr::count(vals, condition, treatment, hours, measure)$n == 3))

# padj for each pair, from the same contrast tables as the figure above
padj_of <- function(file) {
  read_csv(here("output", file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(sub("\\..*", "", gene_id) == GENE_ID) %>%
    transmute(rna_padj, ribo_padj, te_padj, rna_lfc, ribo_lfc, te_lfc) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("measure", ".value"), names_sep = "_") %>%
    mutate(measure = recode(measure, te = "TE"))
}

# Control: siCTRL, normoxia vs hypoxia at each timepoint
ctrl_vals <- vals %>% filter(treatment == "sictrl") %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(str_to_title(condition), c("Normoxia", "Hypoxia")))
ctrl_sig <- map_dfr(c("1hr", "4hr", "24hr"), ~ padj_of(sprintf("translation_categories_%s.csv", .x)) %>%
                      mutate(hours = factor(.x, levels(ctrl_vals$hours))))

# Knockdown: siCTRL vs si3d at 1hr in both conditions. Normoxia uses the 1hr samples and the
# 1hr contrast, not the 1+4hr time-regressed fit: a regressed fit has no per-sample TE values,
# and only the siCTRL arm of a regressed TE was ever saved.
kd_ctx <- c("Normoxia 1hr", "Hypoxia 1hr")
kd_vals <- vals %>%
  filter(hours == "1hr") %>%
  mutate(context = factor(paste(str_to_title(condition), hours), kd_ctx),
         treatment = factor(treatment, c("sictrl", "si3d")))
kd_sig <- bind_rows(
  padj_of("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_normoxia_1hr.csv") %>% mutate(context = kd_ctx[1]),
  padj_of("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv")  %>% mutate(context = kd_ctx[2])
) %>% mutate(context = factor(context, kd_ctx))

vA <- value_panel(ctrl_vals, "hours", "condition",
                  c(Normoxia = "#0072B2", Hypoxia = "#CC79A7"), ctrl_sig,
                  comparison = "hyp vs norm")
vB <- value_panel(kd_vals, "context", "treatment",
                  c(sictrl = "#999999", si3d = "#E69F00"), kd_sig,
                  comparison = "sictrl vs si3d")
# Two separate figures: the control-cell hypoxic response, and the effect of eIF3d knockdown.
ann <- function(title, subtitle)
  plot_annotation(title = title, subtitle = subtitle,
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
                                plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)))
base_sub <- "* = DESeq2 padj < 0.05."

pv_ctrl <- vA + ann(paste(GENE_LABEL, "in MDA-MB-231: hypoxic response in control cells"),
                    paste0(base_sub, "\nlog2FC = log2(hypoxia / normoxia)."))
pv_kd   <- vB + ann(paste(GENE_LABEL, "in MDA-MB-231: effect of eIF3d knockdown"),
                    paste0(base_sub, "\nlog2FC = log2(sictrl / si3d), positive = si3d lowers it. Both conditions at 1hr."))
pv_ctrl
pv_kd

if (params$save_plots) {
  stem <- paste0("gene_rna_te_hypoxia_si3d_231_", GENE_LABEL)
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0(stem, "_values_hypoxia_ctrl.pdf")), pv_ctrl, width = 13, height = 4.5)
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0(stem, "_values_si3d.pdf")),         pv_kd,   width = 11.5, height = 4.5)
  cat("Saved", paste0(stem, c("_values_hypoxia_ctrl.pdf", "_values_si3d.pdf")), sep = "\n")
}
```
